releaseNotes: Smart Life v0.11.67 adds first-stage TikTok Share support without bypassing creator download controls. When TikTok gives Smart Life an actual shared video stream, Smart Life stores a local Library copy and also attempts a Gallery copy on Android 10 or newer. When TikTok shares only a link, Smart Life keeps a clean TikTok Library item instead of failing; short TikTok links are normalized when possible. Library now recognizes TikTok items and includes a TikTok filter. Instagram saving, Home, Files, Notes, Price Photos barcode behavior and existing user data remain unchanged.
